package main

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"unicode/utf8"

	"github.com/ishan5ain/tuiweave"
	"github.com/ishan5ain/tuiweave/agentic/markdown"
)

func main() {
	for _, kind := range []string{"prose", "structured"} {
		data, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(os.Args[1], "agentic/markdown/testdata/streaming", kind+".md"))
		if err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
		unit := string(data) + "\n"
		sources := map[string]string{"fixture": unit}
		for _, size := range []int{2048, 8192, 32768} {
			s := strings.Repeat(unit, (size+len(unit)-1)/len(unit))
			n := size
			for n < len(s) && !utf8.RuneStart(s[n]) {
				n--
			}
			sources[fmt.Sprint(size)] = s[:n]
		}
		if kind == "structured" {
			for _, end := range []string{"**request", "[runbook](https://example.com/", "    return pending < 12\n"} {
				i := strings.Index(unit, end)
				if i < 0 {
					panic("missing checkpoint")
				}
				sources[fmt.Sprintf("prefix-%d", i+len(end))] = unit[:i+len(end)]
			}
		}
		for label, source := range sources {
			for _, width := range []int{40, 80} {
				r := markdown.NewRenderer(tuiweave.Dark())
				out, err := r.Render(source, width)
				if err != nil {
					panic(err)
				}
				fmt.Printf("%s/%s/w%d %x\n", kind, label, width, sha256.Sum256([]byte(out)))
			}
		}
	}
}
